title: Lantern charge in 6 seconds
desc: The L1c lantern charge (ring fist pushed into the lantern's port) squeezed into 6 seconds, with three ways to split the time between filling, overcharging and letting go.

takes.name: L1c charge, C6a timing
takes.facts: fill 4 s (ticks 9-90), overcharge 1 s (90-110), let-go 0.5 s (110-120); 120 ticks total, idle glow 0.12 before/after

takes.name: L1c charge, C6b timing
takes.facts: fill 4.5 s (9-100), overcharge 0.6 s (100-112), let-go 0.4 s (112-120); 120 ticks total, idle glow 0.12 before/after

takes.name: L1c charge, C6c timing
takes.facts: fill 3.3 s (9-75), overcharge 1.5 s (75-105), let-go 0.75 s (105-120); 120 ticks total, idle glow 0.12 before/after
